_comment: Ashen Vale puzzles, read by BellPuzzle.load_config(path, key). bells.required_order lists Bell.index values (0 gate bell, 1 watch bell in the keep, 2 sluice bell) in the order the keepers were laid down: the graveyard headstones (lore keys grave_sluice_keeper, grave_gatekeeper, grave_watch) give the years 3, 7 and 11 of the Quiet, and the chapel lintel (chapel_inscription) says to ring in that order. Change the order here and the headstone text together.
